rdfs:label: dtstart
rdfs:comment: The start date-time of an iCalendar Vevent, Vtodo or Vjournal — when the event begins, when the task becomes actionable, or the date a journal entry refers to.
notes: iCalendar's date-time form, distinct from `as:startTime` (ActivityStreams). Use `dtstart` when you need iCal/CalDAV interop. Value may be xsd:dateTime, xsd:date (all-day), or a floating local date-time with no offset (same wall-clock time in any zone, e.g. "2026-07-21T08:00:00"); timezone via `ical:tzid`. No single rdfs:range is declared because of these variants.

history.note: Comment adds Vjournal; dropped xsd:dateTime rdfs:range (DTSTART may be a date or floating time); notes describe value forms and ical:tzid.
